excerpt: nEXO Pre-Conceptual Design Report. A tonne-scale neutrinoless double beta decay search in 136Xe, based on the ultra-low background liquid xenon technology validated by EXO-200; approximately 5000 kg of xenon enriched to 90% in 136Xe, projected half-life sensitivity of roughly 10^28 years.
title: nEXO Pre-Conceptual Design Report
